title: Localized and common-stage canonical pullback compositors
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $Z\xrightarrow{h}X\xrightarrow{f}Y$ be arbitrary composable scheme morphisms [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with $\ell$ invertible on all three schemes. Use the completed integral, rationalized and common-finite-stage constructible categories and the prescribed pullback functors of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], with localization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and the common-stage objects, representatives and transition comparisons of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Write $c^{\mathcal O_E}_{f,h}:L(fh)^*\cong Lh^*Lf^*$ for the fixed integral pullback compositor of the fixed pullback operations, normalized on the whole coefficient-system pullback. For a rational object $M$ with its unchanged integral representative, define $c^E_{f,h;M}:L(fh)^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh^*Lf^*M$ to be the unique isomorphism whose forward arrow, under the specified pullback-object equalities, is the localization of $c^{\mathcal O_E}_{f,h;M}$. For a common-stage object $M$ define $c^\Omega_{f,h;M}$ to be the unique isomorphism represented at EVERY finite field $L$ containing the stage of $M$ by the composite $p_{fh,M,L}\,c^L_{f,h;M_L}\,Lh^*(p_{f,M,L}^{-1})\,p_{h,Lf^*M,L}^{-1}$, where $p_{f,M,L}:(Lf^*M)_L\cong Lf^*(M_L)$ is the specified common-stage pullback comparison. The representative is taken with the actual source and target via the common-stage class map. These define the existing rational and common-stage pullback compositors with precisely their localization and every-larger-field normalizations, including identity morphisms and arbitrary ramification; no replacement of either compositor by an arbitrary isomorphism is made.
